style: Photographic, soft natural light, calm and premium wellness-brand look. Colour palette of deep forest green, warm cream and ivory, bark brown and sand, with tiny touches of muted gold. Minimal, uncluttered composition with generous empty space. Shallow depth of field, gentle film-like grain. Authentic Kerala, India setting.
avoid: No text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks, no captions. No recognisable faces: show people only from behind, in silhouette, or as hands. No deity statues, idols or heavy religious imagery. No neon colours, no cartoon or illustration style, no clutter.
